Where a word stops: three scanners over one line

The t27a assembler reads a line with three tiny scanners: skip_spaces, name_end and digits_end. Pick a start byte and see where each one stops, and which bytes it walked over.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/isa/t27a.t27 (t27 master 90e797659): every stop is skip_spaces, name_end or digits_end, its fn bodies compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • Course 12 of t27.ai, t27-compiler: lesson 2 opens this widget
